name: SDLC
description: Story-first engineering with the evidence behind each step, in five skills. story writes each change as an outcome, a Not doing list and numbered cases with concrete values, asking only where two readings diverge, and splits or reviews stories. deliver builds one story at a time: a fresh agent writes the failing tests from the story alone, the tests are locked, the session writes the code, one fresh review checks its own findings, and the user confirms before a pull request into main. architecture spikes unknowns and records each expensive decision with the user's reasons. guardrails writes AGENTS.md and the checks. review-code reviews pull requests, the user's own code and designs through the same review agent.
